name: [CARRY] REALISTIC JUMP ROPE
desc:
🎮 | Welcome to Realistic Jump Rope! This game is inspired by the "Squid Game" series. @Netflix (Inspiration)

📜 | Game Rules:

⚖️ | Maintain your balance, survive every challenge, and cross the bridge within 10 minutes.

🤝 | Carry your friend across the bridge and help them reach the other side.

💰 | Complete Quests and Survive rounds to Earn Money. Spend it on tools, crates, outfits, and exclusive items.

🎁 | Like the game & join our Group to unlock FREE rewards!
